description: Access skill for Chinese Wikipedia (zh.wikipedia.org) that extracts structured data

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - search   Search for Wikipedia pages by keyword or phrase
  - get_page   Get comprehensive data from a Wikipedia page including infobox, tables, and medal records
  - get_extract   Get a brief text extract (summary) from a Wikipedia page

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

include_html.description: Whether to fetch and parse HTML content for structured data

sentences.description: Number of sentences in the extract
